verdict.rationale: Ramp's own docs cover each step of the AP workflow in one platform. Invoices are captured by OCR, with line items checked through 2- and 3-way matching. Spend-control approval workflows explicitly apply to bills, and the CLI and Ramp UI support bill approval. Bills are created via POST /bills with a per-bill payment method of card, ACH, check or wire, and NetSuite and Xero bills can be completed with Ramp payments. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration, and only thin detail on how bill approvals are routed (approver chains and rules)—bill approvals are also not yet available via MCP.
